authoritative_content: The viewpoint above Lake Bled is called Ojstrica. It is a short but very steep walk up from the lake, maybe twenty minutes.

semantic.meaning: A description of the Ojstrica viewpoint above Lake Bled, noting the physical effort (short but steep) and duration (~20 minutes) required to reach it from the lake.

definitions.definition: A specific viewpoint located above Lake Bled.
